pitfalls.readme_said: Large File Cleanup's default Quick Scan, which uses Spotlight
pitfalls.actually_needed: Complete Scan from the Start Scan menu: pickfit's macOS VM turns Spotlight indexing off, so Quick Scan said Spotlight is not ready; a Mac with Spotlight on does not need this

judge.observed: The MangoDisk app shows its Deep Cleanup workspace with sidebar tools and a Start Scan prompt.

gui.display: macOS desktop 1280x800 in a tart VM; pickfit's screenshot over VNC from the host

operations.goal: In MangoDisk, go to Large File Cleanup (large files section) in the sidebar. Set the scan location to the folder /Users/sbx/pickfit-plant if it lets you choose a folder, otherwise scan the home folder. Start the scan and wait for results. Look for the file big-video-mangodisk.mov (150 MB) in the results list. Do not delete anything.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "big-video-mangodisk.mov": yes

operations.goal: In MangoDisk, go to Duplicate File Cleanup / Duplicate Cleanup in the sidebar. Set the scan location to /Users/sbx/pickfit-plant/dupes if it lets you choose a folder, otherwise use /Users/sbx/pickfit-plant. Start the scan (use Complete Scan if it asks) and wait for results. Look for duplicate-mangodisk-A.bin in the duplicate groups. Do not delete anything.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "duplicate-mangodisk-A.bin": yes

operations.goal: In MangoDisk, go to Disk Space Analysis in the sidebar. Set the analyzed folder to /Users/sbx/pickfit-plant if it lets you choose, otherwise analyze the home folder. Start the analysis/scan (use Complete Scan if offered) and wait for the treemap/sunburst chart and file list. Find big-video-mangodisk.mov in the results. Do not delete anything.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "big-video-mangodisk.mov": yes

operations.goal: In MangoDisk, go to Deep Cleanup in the sidebar. Start the Scan (use Complete Scan if offered) with default locations and wait for results to finish. Look through the results for the project folder fakeproj under /Users/sbx/pickfit-plant/fakeproj (project build artifacts / node_modules). Do not clean or delete anything.
